notes: 3D: full arena crowd (about 15,500 fans in team colours, reactions to goals, hits and saves) and crowd sound; new hair, helmets and chin straps; goalie masks in team colours that he pushes up at stoppages; new goalie skates; motion-captured get-ups, high shot finishes, fist-pump celebrations and fight punches; players, gloves and sticks no longer pass through each other; straighter necks in board battles. Engine: tight defensive gaps with D facing the carrier, players in the slot shoot far more, loose pucks by the net get played.
